name: Instagram (Facebook Login)

fields.label: Facebook Page access token
fields.description: Existing token from the matching Meta login product. Automatic token refresh is not implemented.

fields.label: Instagram professional account ID
fields.description: Bind this connection to the Instagram account represented by the token; this is not a Facebook Page ID.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Read the bound professional Instagram account identity using the stored access token. A provider identity is required for monitoring evidence.

users.get.title: Get Account
users.get.description: Read the identity of the professional account bound to this connection.

media.list.title: List Media
media.list.description: List one page of media owned by the bound account. Pass after to request a subsequent page; cursor presence alone does not guarantee another page.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from a prior response.

media.get.title: Get Media
media.get.description: Read a published media object visible to this connection. Media CDN URLs can expire.

containers.createImage.title: Create Image Container
containers.createImage.description: Create an unpublished image container from a public JPEG URL. This does not publish. Check container status and explicitly publish when ready.

imageUrl.description: Publicly accessible media URL; Meta retrieves the file.

caption.description: Caption text, subject to provider content limits.

containers.createReel.title: Create Reel Container
containers.createReel.description: Create an unpublished Reel container from a public video URL. Processing is asynchronous; poll containers.get separately, then explicitly publish when FINISHED.

videoUrl.description: Publicly accessible media URL; Meta retrieves the file.

caption.description: Caption text, subject to provider content limits.

shareToFeed.description: Whether the Reel also appears in the feed.

coverUrl.description: Publicly accessible media URL; Meta retrieves the file.

thumbOffset.description: Cover frame offset in milliseconds; coverUrl takes precedence.

containers.get.title: Get Container Status
containers.get.description: Check an unpublished container. FINISHED means ready to publish; IN_PROGRESS means processing; ERROR, EXPIRED and PUBLISHED are terminal states. No automatic polling occurs.

media.publish.title: Publish Media Container
media.publish.description: Publish a previously created container to the bound account. Call containers.get first and publish only when FINISHED. A returned ID identifies the published media; this operation does not retry or poll.

creationId.description: Container ID ready for publication, not a published media ID.

publishing.limit.title: Get Publishing Usage
publishing.limit.description: Read current publishing usage and provider quota configuration. Quotas may differ by account and API behavior; no fixed cap is assumed.

insights.account.get.title: Get account insights
insights.account.get.description: Read Instagram professional account insights for the bound account.

insights.media.get.title: Get media insights
insights.media.get.description: Read insights for one published Instagram media object.

comments.list.title: List comments
comments.list.description: List comments on a published Instagram media object.

comments.get.title: Get comment
comments.get.description: Read one Instagram comment by ID.

comments.create.title: Create comment
comments.create.description: Create a comment on a published Instagram media object.

comments.delete.title: Delete comment
comments.delete.description: Delete an Instagram comment owned by or visible to this connection.

comments.hide.title: Hide comment
comments.hide.description: Hide or unhide an Instagram comment on media owned by the bound account.

hide.description: True hides the comment; false unhides it.

stories.list.title: List stories
stories.list.description: List currently live Instagram stories for the bound professional account.

tags.list.title: List tagged media
tags.list.description: List media objects in which the bound professional account is tagged.

hashtags.search.title: Search hashtags
hashtags.search.description: Search for an Instagram hashtag ID by name using the bound professional account.

hashtags.topMedia.list.title: List hashtag top media
hashtags.topMedia.list.description: List top media for an Instagram hashtag ID using the bound professional account.

businessDiscovery.get.title: Get business discovery
businessDiscovery.get.description: Read public metadata about another Instagram professional account by username.

containers.create.title: Create media container
containers.create.description: Create an unpublished image, Reel or story container from a public URL. Omit mediaType for a plain image; REELS requires videoUrl and STORIES accepts either URL. This does not publish; poll containers.get and publish explicitly when ready.

mediaType.description: Container media type. Omit for a plain image; Meta treats the deprecated VIDEO type as REELS.

imageUrl.description: Publicly accessible JPEG URL; Meta retrieves the file.

videoUrl.description: Publicly accessible MP4 or MOV URL; Meta retrieves the file.

caption.description: Caption text, subject to provider content limits.

altText.description: Alternative text for an image container.

shareToFeed.description: Whether a Reel also appears in the feed.

coverUrl.description: Publicly accessible cover image URL for a Reel.

thumbOffset.description: Cover frame offset in milliseconds; coverUrl takes precedence.

locationId.description: Facebook Page ID of a location to tag.

isCarouselItem.description: Marks an image or video container as a carousel child.

containers.createCarousel.title: Create carousel container
containers.createCarousel.description: Create an unpublished carousel container from 2-10 child container IDs. Children must be FINISHED before the carousel is published.

children.description: Comma-separated list of 2-10 image or video container IDs in slide order.

caption.description: Caption text, subject to provider content limits.

locationId.description: Facebook Page ID of a location to tag.

media.children.list.title: List carousel children
media.children.list.description: List the media objects inside a carousel album. Child media do not expose insights; query those at the parent album level.

media.setCommentEnabled.title: Set media comment availability
media.setCommentEnabled.description: Enable or disable new comments on an owned published media object. Live video media is not supported.

mediaId.description: Numeric Graph API ID of owned published Instagram media.

commentEnabled.description: True enables new comments; false disables them.

comments.replies.list.title: List comment replies
comments.replies.list.description: List replies to a top-level Instagram comment.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from a prior response.

before.description: Opaque before cursor from a prior response.

comments.replies.create.title: Create comment reply
comments.replies.create.description: Reply to a top-level Instagram comment. Replies to replies attach to the top-level comment and hidden comments cannot be answered.

message.description: Reply text, subject to provider content limits.

conversations.get.title: Get conversation
conversations.get.description: Read one Instagram DM conversation, including its participants, by conversation ID.

fields.description: Comma-separated conversation fields such as id, updated_time, participants.

conversations.list.title: List conversations
conversations.list.description: List one page of Instagram DM conversations for the bound professional account. Pass userId to find the conversation with one participant; request-folder conversations inactive for 30 days are omitted by the provider.

userId.description: Instagram-scoped user ID (IGSID) of one participant.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from a prior response.

fields.description: Comma-separated conversation fields such as id, is_owner, messages, participants, updated_time.

conversations.listByPage.title: List page conversations
conversations.listByPage.description: List conversations on a Facebook Page. Set platform to INSTAGRAM to keep only Instagram conversations.

pageId.description: Facebook Page ID whose conversations are read.

platform.description: Platform filter; INSTAGRAM returns Instagram conversations only.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from a prior response.

messages.list.title: List messages
messages.list.description: List one page of messages in an Instagram DM conversation. Only the 20 most recent messages expose their full details.

fields.description: Comma-separated message fields such as id, created_time, from, to, message.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from a prior response.

messages.sendText.title: Send text message
messages.sendText.description: Send a text DM to an Instagram user in an existing conversation. The recipient must have messaged the account within the provider messaging window.

recipientId.description: Recipient Instagram-scoped user ID (IGSID), not a username.

text.description: Message text, up to the provider byte limit.

messages.sendImage.title: Send image message
messages.sendImage.description: Send one image DM by public URL to an Instagram user in an existing conversation.

recipientId.description: Recipient Instagram-scoped user ID (IGSID), not a username.

imageUrl.description: Publicly accessible image URL; Meta retrieves the file.

messages.markSeen.title: Mark messages seen
messages.markSeen.description: Send the mark_seen sender action for one Instagram user. Marking is visible to the recipient and requires an open messaging window.

recipientId.description: Recipient Instagram-scoped user ID (IGSID), not a username.

mentions.reply.title: Reply to mention
mentions.reply.description: Reply to a caption or comment mention by creating a comment on the media that contains it. Stories mentions and tagged-photo comments are not supported.

mediaId.description: Media ID that contains the mention.

message.description: Reply text posted as a comment.

commentId.description: Comment ID of the mention; omit to comment on the media itself.

liveMedia.list.title: List live media
liveMedia.list.description: List live video media broadcasting at request time for the bound professional account.

fields.description: Comma-separated media fields such as id, media_type, media_url, timestamp, permalink.

since.description: Unix timestamp lower bound for time-based pagination.

until.description: Unix timestamp upper bound for time-based pagination.

nodes.getMultiple.title: Get multiple nodes
nodes.getMultiple.description: Read one shared field projection for several Graph nodes in a single request, preserving the provider's ID-to-object mapping.

ids.description: Comma-separated Graph node IDs, up to 50 per call.

fields.description: Optional exact field projection valid for every requested node.

messengerProfile.get.title: Get messenger profile
messengerProfile.get.description: Read messaging configuration for the bound professional account, such as ice breakers and the persistent menu.

fields.description: Comma-separated messenger profile fields such as ice_breakers or persistent_menu.

messengerProfile.update.title: Update messenger profile
messengerProfile.update.description: Set ice breaker questions for the bound professional account. At most four questions are supported.

question.description: Suggested question shown when a conversation starts.

payload.description: Payload delivered when the question is tapped.

messengerProfile.delete.title: Delete messenger profile fields
messengerProfile.delete.description: Remove ice breakers or the persistent menu from the messenger profile of the bound professional account.

subscribedApps.list.title: List subscribed apps
subscribedApps.list.description: List the apps enabled for webhook notifications on the bound professional account, including their subscribed fields.

subscribedApps.subscribe.title: Enable webhook subscriptions
subscribedApps.subscribe.description: Enable webhook fields for delivery to the bound professional account. The Meta app must be Live with Advanced Access and a configured callback before this is used.

subscribedFields.description: Comma-separated webhook fields such as comments, live_comments, messages, messaging_postbacks.

description: Read professional Instagram media and insights, moderate comments, manage messaging conversations and webhook subscriptions, and explicitly create, inspect, and publish public-URL containers.
